name: Tirnach Unit 158 Original
description: This listing is a flint-temper glost kiln listed with peak temperature 392 degrees Celsius, chamber capacity 774 litres, heat up 177 minutes. Its remaining stated figures are cycles before relining 1700 cycles, unit price set after acceptance, heat source induction. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.
